measurement_policy.note: amendement opérateur 2026-09-21: aucun benchmark complet avant TICKET-19; T14-T18 utilisent uniquement des samples/smokes bornés; le premier benchmark complet est T19 (--sample-profile full)
measurement_policy.sample_selection_rule: deterministic_stratified_smoke_v1: for each dev label with support>0 in fixed taxonomy order (menace excluded, support=0 - nothing fabricated), select the lexicographically first sample_id; exactly one record per label

rules: measure the bounded real smoke exactly (gate 0.90/0.20 R1-R3, prompts V1, frozen policy) — no tuning before the full T19 benchmark
no RAG, no vision, no fine-tuning, no alternate model, no selective retry, no budget change to improve a score
provider failures, timeouts and abstentions stay in every denominator
unknown cost is never turned into zero; provider-billed and estimated values are preserved separately
A/B/C audit invariants (docs/contracts.md §2.6.1) are validated before any B−A / C−B delta is published
smoke results are diagnostic only; they never support a performance claim
no push, no merge; changes left for human review

runtime.note: openai/gpt-oss-20b is limited to authorized technical smoke tests and never contributes to official Gold metrics

split_policy: dev only for TICKET-14; gold_test.jsonl is an internal POC validation partition never opened during development; the terminal test evaluation belongs to the later authorized ticket (T19)
